body: Detective Pikachu is Creatures' Nintendo 3DS adventure about Tim Goodman and a talking Pikachu investigating a series of mysteries. Tim can understand his unusual companion, allowing Pikachu's confidence and opinions to become part of their working relationship. The adventure first appeared in Japan as the shorter Birth of a New Duo in 2016, before the expanded worldwide release in 2018. It approaches the Pokémon world through observation and conversation, giving familiar creatures roles as witnesses, suspects or sources of practical help in cases that need to be understood.

The pair collect information from the characters they meet and inspect the places where an incident has occurred. Tim's search for his missing father supplies a larger reason to follow the clues, while smaller cases give the partnership immediate work. A Pokémon's behaviour can be part of the evidence rather than a signal to begin a battle. That changes the player's attention. Recognising a creature still matters, but the useful question is what it has seen, how it relates to the location and whether its actions explain something about the case.

Pikachu's voice makes the companion more than an expressive presence beside the human lead. He can propose an explanation, react to a clue or reveal part of his own uncertain past. Tim's ability to understand him gives their conversations a private quality inside a world where other people hear something different. The narrative adventure format makes room for those exchanges between investigations. Detective Pikachu finds its identity in a simple change to a familiar relationship: the creature at the player's side can now argue, reason and share the work aloud.
